name: Graph on top, data below
why: The top half shows the whole graph top-down, with each loop on a ring and its exit off the ring. The bottom half shows plain data of one step run, its ways out as buttons, and a prev/next pager. A tap on a node opens a step page with all passes. Best for calm review. Weak for very large graphs.
